data.title: Tracked technology layoffs (Layoffs.fyi)
data.summary: A privately maintained tracker that compiles publicly reported layoff events at technology and startup companies worldwide, revised as new reports arrive. It is not a statistical census. It records 165,269 employees in 2022, 265,660 in 2023, 152,922 in 2024, 122,606 in 2025 and 127,180 between 1 January and 24 August 2026.
data.citation: Layoffs.fyi — Tech and Startup Layoff Tracker, per-year pages, retrieved 27 August 2026.
